commentary_title: Aframax tonnage demand to be firm next week
commentary_summary: The Aframax market ended on a high in week 40 with rates increasing on most routes towards the end of the week. However, as markets were slow in the previous week, the tonne-miles index ended the week at 99.4 points. | Recent developments in the Middle East caused many vessels to depart for other routes, spiking up rates in the region. Meanwhile, the reopening of Libyan oil ports is expected to drive up the tonnage demand in the region. | The markets in the USG saw some gains in week 40 as most vessels were able to find employment. However, incoming ballast tonnage could curb the growth in freight rates next week.
